newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips trim losses, techs hold firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips trim losses, techs hold firm.

text.p: U.S. blue chips bounced off their lows but remained unable to press into the plus column in afternoon activity on Monday.

The Dow industrials stood at 8172, off 22 points for the day. The New York Stock Exchange lifted its index-arbitrage program trading curbs at 1420 EDT/1820 GMT, just 12 minutes after activating the restrictions.
Analysts said that despite two straight jittery sessions, the Dow was not displaying signs that a serious downturn was at hand.

"This has a temporary look to it," said Greg Nie, technical analyst at EVEREN Securities. "The volume levels support that, because we had contracting volume early Friday and noticeably contracting volume today."
Declining issues held to a slender 15-13 lead on the NYSE, where volume totalled about 340 million shares.
A strong performance by chip stocks helped hold the Nasdaq Composite seven points higher at 1602. Intel Corp continued to lead the way, gaining 2-5/8 to 96-3/8.
